meta.title: Services: Control Tower, back office and data | Intello
meta.description: Processes we design and run for logistics companies: end-to-end Control Tower, billing and audits, ETL and business intelligence.

header.title: Processes we design and run
header.lede: We take on complete operational and back-office processes, with a documented SOP, defined owners and reporting. Start with one and grow when the numbers prove it.

items.title: End-to-end Control Tower
items.summary: We coordinate, track and control air, ocean and ground shipments, from production at origin to order closing. We anticipate risks before they become costs.
items.indexText: Order and shipment follow-up, documents, customs and closing.

phases.title: Pre-shipment: before departure
points: We manage open orders and monitor production at origin.
We track cargo ready date against the need-by date at destination.
We build an integrated ETA forecast from order placement.
phases.see: early alerts on deviations that put the season at risk.

phases.title: Activation and setup
points: We receive the purchase order and acknowledge it with the supplier.
We confirm the Ready Date and escalate any delay.
We log the PO in the tracking platform: value, incoterm, supplier.
phases.see: every PO visible from day one.

phases.title: Origin coordination
points: We follow the booking with the supplier or forwarder until space is confirmed.
We check the itinerary meets the client's need.
phases.see: estimated ETD and ETA from the start.

phases.title: Document management
points: We review commercial invoice, packing list and BL/AWB drafts against the PO.
We verify consignee, weights and packages before final issue.
phases.see: the client approves; we ensure consistency.

phases.title: Transit and monitoring
points: Scheduled status sweeps: Monday, Wednesday and Friday, or every 2 to 3 days for ocean.
ETA cross-checked on shipping line and carrier platforms.
Transshipment watch and geofence: alert when the vessel is 20 km from the destination port.
phases.see: delays and itinerary changes reported at once.

phases.title: Release and clearance
points: Preliminary audit of invoices and transport documents.
Pre-alert package that enables pre-clearance, five days before ETA.
phases.see: duties and release with continuous visibility.

phases.title: Delivery, returns and closing
points: Monitoring of delivery appointments and windows at warehouse or plant.
BL release and preventive demurrage and detention control.
Incident management, POD and equipment return.
phases.see: order closing and billing cycle support.

items.title: Logistics back office
items.summary: Every operation runs on its own documented, versioned SOP. With that method we take on the administrative processes behind the logistics operation.

figure.label: wall-to-wall audits, US and Panama warehouses

items.indexText: Outsourced billing and inventory audits with reconciliation.

services.title: Outsourced billing
services.text: We run billing processes end to end.
bullets: Charges validated against the agreed cost structure
Status uploads to the client's portals
Billing cycle closed with each operation

services.title: Wall-to-wall inventory audits
services.text: We design optimizations for full inventory audits.
bullets: Warehouses in the United States, including Miami, and Panama

items.title: Data and reporting
items.summary: Every process we run leaves a trail of structured data. We extract, clean and integrate it into business intelligence suites with granular metrics.
items.indexText: Automated ETL, business intelligence and reporting by country.

etl.text: daily and weekly reports from clients, suppliers and tracking platforms.
against master records: suppliers, divisions, countries and ports.
different sources into one granular base, from one line per shipment to one line per item.
client data every week: open orders, receivables, inventory and freight rates.

capabilities.title: One regional truth
capabilities.text: Consolidated visibility by country, with history ready for audits and analysis.

capabilities.title: Data Intelligence Hub
capabilities.text: Models that bring in client sources, such as distribution center inventory or duty projections.

capabilities.title: Information arrives
capabilities.text: Operational email, automated reports by country and query portals.

capabilities.title: Conversational logistics
capabilities.text: An assistant to query the operation by talking to its own data.

items.title: SOP per account
items.text: We map, document and version every process: scope, roles, flow, checklists and templates.

items.title: Channels by stage
items.text: Separate communication threads for origin, transit, customs and closing, with every shipment traced.

items.title: RACI matrix
items.text: Every activity has an owner, approver, consulted and informed party across client, supplier, agent and Intello.

items.title: Proactive triggers
items.text: Scheduled status sweeps and automatic alerts, such as the pre-alert five days before ETA.

items.title: Risk management
items.text: Probability and impact matrix for itinerary changes, document delays, incoterms and free days.

items.title: Reports and portals
items.text: Client dashboards, recurring reports and status uploads to each client's portals.

steps.title: Map
steps.body: A 30-minute conversation to understand one process: volume, systems and pain points.

steps.title: Design
steps.body: We return a process map with a draft SOP, RACI and success metrics.

steps.title: Pilot
steps.body: We run that process, measured against the agreed metrics.

steps.title: Scale
steps.body: If the numbers hold, we take on the next process.
